protocol.models: per-fold StandardScaler + L2 logistic C=1 (direction) / ridge alpha=1 (volatility)

arms.s0: Born-rule observables used directly (p_up for direction, std*sigma_h for volatility)

exploration.selection_rule: rank candidates (control excluded) by (1) number of the 16 cells with positive delta IC, (2) pooled row-weighted delta IC, (3) median delta IC

ablation_summary.rule: claim only if a metric has >=9/16 improving cells and >=9/16 improving cells with paired bootstrap p-value below the Bonferroni threshold
ablation_summary.verdict: null: no evidence the with_schrodinger arm adds skill (pre-registered majority + Bonferroni rule not met)
